name: Laravel 12 Event System Management
description: Event and listener creation workflow for Laravel 12

steps.content:
📡 Laravel 12 Event System:

✅ Use constructor property promotion in events
✅ Implement ShouldBroadcast for real-time updates
✅ Add ShouldQueue to listeners for async processing
✅ Use proper type hints in event data
✅ Register events in bootstrap/providers.php
✅ Implement proper error handling
✅ Use event discovery for auto-registration
✅ Add proper logging for debugging
